# Project Agent Pointer

Keep this file short. It points at project memory; it does not inline it.

## Memory

- Decisions: `.opencode/memory/decisions.md`
- Environment: `.opencode/memory/environment.md`
- Lessons: `.opencode/memory/lessons.md`

Read only the file relevant to the current task. Do not read all three by default.
Do not commit project memory if the project treats `.opencode/memory/` as local; keep
those files ignored.

## Local rules

- Add project-specific instructions here only when confirmed.
- Do not invent preferences or environment facts.
